purpose: CPU-only, Windows x86_64 standalone scanner-POC distribution layout for the manifest-validated local CNN observation runtime.
runtime_behavior: no Visual C++ redistributable DLL dependency
Windows 10 Universal CRT API-set DLLs supplied by the operating system
no runtime network access, telemetry, persistence, or model download
full canonical matching paths only with --show-paths
non_claims: This is a scanner observation POC, not a calibrated hybrid classification or policy release.
A successful cross-build and PE import inspection alone are not native platform qualification.

platform_prerequisites.windows-x86_64-standalone: 64-bit Windows 10 or later. The bundle intentionally supplies no non-system DLLs; normal Windows system DLLs, including the Windows 10 Universal CRT API-set DLLs, remain operating-system dependencies.

integrity: SHA-256 checksums cover every regular file in the unpacked bundle except CHECKSUMS.sha256 itself.
